run_adsorbml_calculations: run the AdsorbMLRunner calculate method to find global minima adsorption energy for slab-adsorbate systems
initialize_adsorbml_runner: create an AdsorbMLRunner instance with an ASE calculator, input data path, and relaxation parameters
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file using the write_results method
configure_adsorbml_optimization: configure AdsorbMLRunner with custom optimizer class, force convergence threshold, and max relaxation steps
run_adsorbml_with_energy_model: run AdsorbMLRunner calculate with the adsorption energy model enabled to use DFT relaxed slabs
